arms.note: A0-oracle: the flat prompt, handed a preselected evidence set built from the recorded A2 run for the same instance. One call, no loop, no funnel. The arm exists to isolate the loop from the evidence.

queries.text: Of these eight retrieval papers - arXiv 2603.22587, 2603.20513, 2603.13301, 2602.16932, 2604.27934, 2604.27724, 2604.27591, 2604.27283 - how many report a numeric result on the BEIR benchmark? Answer with one integer and cite the chunk that carries each number.

Of these eight causal-discovery papers - arXiv 2602.16435, 2602.09207, 2602.08629, 2602.04907, 2604.28087, 2604.27495, 2604.27167, 2604.27011 - how many compare against NOTEARS with a numeric result? Answer with one integer and cite the chunk that carries each number.
